properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 key-derivation packages in the truffle lockfile, via three packages: pbkdf2 3.x (Node/browserify KDF polyfill, used by ganache-cli/web3 stack), @ethersproject/pbkdf2 5.5.0 (ethers v5 BIP39 mnemonic/wallet KDF), and @types/pbkdf2 (TypeScript typings companion — declaration-only entries but part of the same shipped dependency). PBKDF2 is a password KDF, not Shor-vulnerable; its parameter strength lives at the callers not in these lockfile lines. No first-party call site in the application c

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider in the shipped build: tweetnacl implements Ed25519 signatures, X25519 key exchange and XSalsa20-Poly1305 AE — all classical, Shor-vulnerable primitives (except the symmetric AE). Two copies resolved in the truffle lockfile: 0.14.5 (ethereumjs-util/sshpk path) and 1.0.3 (eth-sig-util). No first-party call site in the application; the image ships these algorithms regardless.
